corrections.description: Paint the iris like MHS3: muted colour, a dark band across the top, fine radial lines and lighter rings.
Tint the sclera grey-white and add a grey shadow band under the upper lid.
Make the eye opening a narrower almond (less white showing).
Draw the brows as darker brush strokes with hatching, angled down to the nose.
Add many thin pale painted streaks and a third, lighter tone to the hair clumps.
Soften the face shadow edges and add the small painted shadows (under the nose and lower lip, cheekbone).
Vary the outline weight, heavier under the jaw.
